title: Live auction fanout: pruning connections while broadcasting to a room
name: Auction room broadcast

questions.prompt: Bidders in the live auction room say they sometimes miss a competing bid and get outbid without ever seeing it on screen. It seems to happen right after someone on a bad connection drops out of the room, and the bidder who misses the update is never the one who dropped. Fix live/hub.ts so the tests pass.
